# cad-modeling

用 SolidCraft 做参数化 3D CAD 建模：MCP server，加上官方推荐的 4 个建模 skill（新建零件、修改设计、参数与 STEP 校验、装配与机构）。需要先安装 SolidCraft。

| 类型 | 名称 | 说明 | 来源 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| mcp | `solidcraft` | SolidCraft 的 MCP server（stdio）：Agent 用和界面相同的命令建模（batch、execute、measure、screenshot…）；无界面时自带设计会话，桌面应用运行时自动连接，可以看着 Agent 建模。 | original |
| skill | `solidcraft-modeling` | Use when building a new part, enclosure, bracket, plate, flange or any other 3D solid in SolidCraft through its MCP server (tools such as batch, execute, measure, screenshot), or when a SolidCraft session is using many tool calls or tokens. | [tangency-labs/solidcraft](https://github.com/tangency-labs/solidcraft/tree/main/skills/solidcraft-modeling) · MIT OR Apache-2.0 |
| skill | `solidcraft-editing` | Use when changing, fixing or extending an existing SolidCraft design through its MCP server - a .sc file (or an older .solidcraft one) or the design open in the app. Typical requests: resize it, move a cut, change a hole or standoff, add a fillet or chamfer, make a fixed value parametric, or a feature shows an error after a change or after the app crashed. | [tangency-labs/solidcraft](https://github.com/tangency-labs/solidcraft/tree/main/skills/solidcraft-editing) · MIT OR Apache-2.0 |
| skill | `solidcraft-checking` | Use alongside solidcraft-modeling and solidcraft-editing whenever you build, change or port a SolidCraft design. Checks for errors SolidCraft does not report (parameter ranges, every allowed value, exact STEP comparison), regression tests, designs kept in git, porting from build123d, CadQuery, OpenSCAD or STEP. | [tangency-labs/solidcraft](https://github.com/tangency-labs/solidcraft/tree/main/skills/solidcraft-checking) · MIT OR Apache-2.0 |
| skill | `solidcraft-mechanisms` | Use when building, driving or animating an assembly or mechanism in SolidCraft through its MCP server - components, grounding, joints and joint origins, rigid groups, motion links, closed loops such as an actuator on a hinged panel or a linkage, contact sets, motion studies, degrees of freedom - or when a drive moves nothing, stops early or a part jumps when it is joined. To model the parts themselves, use solidcraft-modeling. | [tangency-labs/solidcraft](https://github.com/tangency-labs/solidcraft/tree/main/skills/solidcraft-mechanisms) · MIT OR Apache-2.0 |

## 安装

```bash
claude plugin marketplace add hidontknow/agent-kit
claude plugin install cad-modeling@agent-kit
```
